speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
text: COVID-19 has reinforced the imperative for businesses and individuals worldwide to be digitally-ready.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
text: Further, in a digital age where our common spaces are no longer just physical, MCI will protect our online and offline spaces, and build trust in our institutions and cohesion in our society through public communications and engagement.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
text: The jobs for both fresh graduates and mid-career professionals will be in growth areas like cloud computing, artificial intelligence (AI), cybersecurity, data analytics, software and network engineering, as well as executive roles in business transformation for companies going digital.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
text: Companies have been going digital to enhance productivity, build new businesses, and grow internationally.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
text: MCI will promote a vibrant ecosystem for digital transformation through international connectivity, progressive regulation, and public-private partnerships.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
text: To help companies access growth in Asia and beyond, Singapore is developing an international network of Digital Economy Agreements (DEAs) with like-minded countries, to establish interoperable digital systems and frameworks for data flows and electronic transactions, and ensure an open digital trade architecture.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
text: The Infocomm Media Development Authority (IMDA), together with Enterprise Singapore (ESG) and the National Research Foundation (NRF), will build on the National Innovation Challenges to catalyse the development of new products, services, and business models that will better position sectors such as logistics, maritime, and modern services for growth in a digital era.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
text: MCI and Digital Industry Singapore (DISG) will continue engaging large global tech companies as investors, industry partners, and policy stakeholders.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
text: We will support the growth of local digital champions in areas such as AI, cybersecurity, communications, and digital platform services, assisting them with talent acquisition, market access, and capability building.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
text: We will also raise the digital capabilities of our enterprises, equipping them with digital tools to transact seamlessly, access overseas opportunities, and create good jobs.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
text: Singapore's innovation ecosystem will be empowered by our investments in world-class infrastructure, as well as research and development (R&D).

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
text: We are building a secure and resilient 5G communications network, which will provide the foundation for innovative applications and services.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
text: We will grow indigenous capabilities in technologies that drive value creation.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
text: MCI will collaborate with academia, industry, and other partners to strengthen R&D and translation capabilities, particularly in data, AI, cybersecurity, media, and communications technology.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
text: MCI aims to enable every Singaporean to thrive in a digital society.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
text: We will ensure that all Singaporeans have a baseline level of affordable digital access, especially vulnerable groups such as low-income seniors and families.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
text: Singaporeans will be equipped with the digital skills and literacy needed to go online safely and confidently.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
text: The SG Digital Office, which brings together Digital Ambassadors, volunteers, as well as corporate and community partners to drive the nationwide digitalisation movement, exemplifies the importance of working with the community to bridge the "digital divide".

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
text: Libraries and archives provide trusted information services and inclusive social spaces that foster lifelong learning and an appreciation of Singapore's history.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
text: The National Library Board (NLB) will roll out a five-year Libraries and Archives Plan to prepare Singaporeans for a digital future.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
text: Partnerships with volunteers and organisations will create more opportunities for people to learn together, connect with our shared history and culture, and engage with curated content and customised services, both physical and digital.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
text: NLB will strengthen access to services for segments of our society, such as working professionals, who require more curated resources for learning and skills development.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
text: The Government adopts a balanced approach towards content regulation, both on the Internet and in other media, to facilitate informed media consumption choices and to expand the common space for diverse views that respect our society's values, while protecting our social harmony.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
text: We will continue to refine our content guidelines in consultation with independent advisory panels and stakeholders across the community, to reflect our evolving societal norms and diversity of perspectives.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
text: We will also nurture and support local media companies, who play key roles in our news and social media landscape.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
text: The focus will be broadened beyond Information Technology systems to include Operational Technology.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
text: CSA will maintain vigilance over the evolving threat landscape, and develop tools to protect Singapore's cyberspace from new and emerging forms of cyber-attacks.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
text: Singapore will also work with our international partners to build a resilient and secure international rules-based order in cyberspace.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
text: Ultimately, the most important line of defence against digital harms is a well-informed and discerning citizenry.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
text: We will deal with evolving digital harms, by drawing on the collective responsibility and capability of the Government, industry, and our citizens.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
text: MCI will play its part to strengthen social cohesion and trust in the Government through timely, accessible, and inclusive Government communications.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
text: MCI has leveraged a range of traditional and digital media platforms, including mobile messaging applications in our official languages, to reach Singaporeans of different age groups and backgrounds.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
text: MCI will explore new ways to disseminate official information in the vernacular languages.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
text: MCI will work with all its stakeholders, including through the Government's engagement platform REACH and industry associations, to understand their concerns and seek suggestions on policy challenges.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mr S Iswaran)
text: Together, we will seize new opportunities and forge a thriving digital future for all.
